=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:228-240 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `.github/ai/` snapshot overlay block is still in the PR head (83f9a1d), although several editor summaries say it was deleted. It runs for every caller rather than only on `--tests-file`, copies tracked top-level `.github/ai/*` files into `${root}/source` (`/source`), and adds a new `snapshot_failed` exit to the default path.
  WHY: This breaks "Existing callers and the default path are unchanged" and the strictly additive / append-only constraints, and neither fragment documents it. An `install` failure now aborts default runs with `snapshot_failed`, and the change ships to consumer repos. Severity disagreement: gemini rated it BLOCKER; sonnet, minimax, luna and glm rated it MAJOR. Gemini also cited lines 225-243 (original PR diff numbering).
- scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:228-240 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The overlay copies tracked `.github/ai/` files into the container's `/source` outside the `review_untrusted_workspace.py` snapshot filter that the wrapper's header contract (lines 1-18) declares.
  WHY: On every gate run, tracked `.github/ai/` content reaches the test container without passing the documented credential-name filter. Reviewers call this a declared-vs-effective capability gap, not a demonstrated secret leak. Severity disagreement: minimax rated it MAJOR; gemini and glm rated it NIT (cited lines 233-239).
- tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py:855-871 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `test_wrapper_lists_uncommitted_tracked_edits_and_overlays_command_inputs` still commits `.github/ai/label_contract.v1.json` (line 855), captures `ls -a "$src/.github/ai"` (line 862) and asserts the file is in the `/source` listing (lines 870-871), so it contract-tests the out-of-scope overlay.
  WHY: Once the overlay is removed, the line 871 assertion fails and the gate reports a caused failure. That starts a repair turn that re-adds the overlay block, so the test edits must be reverted in the same change that deletes the block.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:825-858 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `classify_baseline` marks a multi-`::name` unit as ambiguous only when exactly one tree exits 4 or 5 (an XOR on `pr_missing`). Take a unit where one name is missing on both trees and a sibling fails only on the PR tree: both trees exit 4, so the unit is classified as inherited.
  WHY: Pytest's collection error means the sibling nodes never ran on either tree. `run_gate` then returns `status=pass` with zero failures, which hides a failure the change caused (a false pass). Line ranges cited: sonnet and glm 840-855, gemini 825-858, luna 841-854.
- changelog.d/prepush-gate-tests-file.md:2 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The changelog still says without conditions: "A listed test that does not exist on the merge-base (for example one the change added) counts as caused by the change, not inherited." `classify_baseline` now reports multi-name 4/5 baselines and names missing on the PR tree only as `unverified`/`baseline_error`; minimax adds that a name missing on both trees is reported as inherited.
  WHY: Only the documentation is wrong. Release-note readers will expect `status=fail` where the gate returns `status=unverified`, and the changelog contradicts the updated agents.d fragment.
- scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:67-74, 99-105 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The script logs `outcome=unverified reason=usage_error` for a trailing `--tests-file` with no value. The reviewer asks for robust exit handling across all the new `--tests-file` failure states.
  WHY: If the wrapper exits early or incorrectly in the new error states, callers that expect standard JSON output or a specific log format may fail.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:133, 1446-1458 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `_TESTS_FILE_CONTROL_RE`/`parse_tests_file` miss C1 control characters such as U+0085 at line edges: `raw.strip()` removes them, but the regex only covers ASCII up to DEL.
  WHY: A list entry that begins or ends with U+0085 runs its test instead of being rejected as `tests_file_control_character`. Sonnet and glm raised the same issue as a hardening suggestion (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh: add --tests-file <path> ... Existing callers and the default path are unchanged." / "It is strictly additive: this file ships to consumer repos, and the existing `run` arguments and default behaviour are unchanged." / "Stay inside the listed files, use append-only edits" (issue #8461 Scope/Constraints); remove the .github/ai/ snapshot overlay block
  expected_change_site: scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh lines 228-240 (overlay block), and tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py lines 855, 862 and 870-871
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The removal never landed, and the last-run diff (83f9a1d) touches only agents.d, the tail of the test file and the hook. The overlay block and its test assertions are still in the PR diff and on disk at HEAD, even though the editor's summaries say they were deleted. The block runs for every caller regardless of `--tests-file`, writes previously excluded `.github/ai/` files into `/source`, and adds a new `snapshot_failed` synthetic-result exit to the default path.
- requirement: "Document it only through the listed `agents.d/` fragment, not `agents.md`." (issue #8461 Constraints)
  expected_change_site: agents.d/prepush-gate-tests-file.md and changelog.d/prepush-gate-tests-file.md
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Neither fragment mentions the `.github/ai/` overlay behaviour, yet the wrapper performs it for every caller.
- requirement: "--tests-file runs exactly the listed files and ::name entries on both trees."
  expected_change_site: workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py, `plan_units` handling for `prepush_test_command` overrides and script-style Python tests
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The override branch passes only entry paths, without names, and reports `tests_file_names_ignored` (lines 584-593). The `python3 <file>` fallback runs the whole file and reports the same reason (lines 617-621 / 618-621). The added tests lock in this behaviour. Sonnet and glm explicitly judged this not a gap: both cases are reported as `unverified` with `tests_file_names_ignored` and documented in agents.d, and glm adds that applying names under a `run {files}` override cannot be implemented.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:classify_baseline, lines 840-855 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The ambiguity check `pr_missing != (baseline_rcs.get(unit["id"]) in (4, 5)) and (...)` marks a unit ambiguous only when exactly one tree exits 4 or 5. A merged multi-name unit with one name missing on both trees therefore lands in `inherited_ids`.
  WHY: `run_gate` (lines 930-937) gets `pr_caused == []` and returns `status=pass`, so a test the change broke is hidden. Suggested fix: `multi and (pr_missing or base_missing)`, or treat a 4/5 exit on the PR tree alone as ambiguous.
- tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py:test_wrapper_lists_uncommitted_tracked_edits_and_overlays_command_inputs, lines 855, 862, 870-871 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The three `.github/ai/` overlay test edits are still at HEAD 83f9a1d, although two editor summaries say they were reverted.
  WHY: Once the overlay block is removed, the line 871 assertion fails, the gate reports the test as caused, and the repair loop restarts. Revert all three edits together with the block deletion.
- scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:lines 228-240 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `.github/ai/` overlay block is still in the PR head. It is not gated on `tests_file_given`/`tests_file_real`, copies `.github/ai/*` files into `${root}/source`, and adds a `snapshot_failed` exit to the default path. agents.d says the opposite ("Existing callers ... see no change").
  WHY: Every existing gate run now tests against a different `/source`, which breaks "Existing callers and the default path are unchanged" and "Stay inside the listed files, use append-only edits", and the change ships to consumer repos. Fix: delete lines 228-240, check with `grep -n "github/ai" scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh`, and revert the test edits.
- changelog.d/prepush-gate-tests-file.md:line 2 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The changelog still states the old rule without conditions ("A listed test that does not exist on the merge-base ... counts as caused by the change, not inherited"), but multi-name/PR-only-missing cases are now `unverified`/`baseline_error`.
  WHY: Only the documentation is wrong. Readers will expect `status=fail` where the gate returns `status=unverified`.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh: add --tests-file <path> ... Existing callers and the default path are unchanged." and "Stay inside the listed files, use append-only edits." (The editor summaries also say the overlay was removed.)
  Expected change site: scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh lines 228-240, and tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py lines 855, 862 and 870-871
  Evidence of absence: The removal never landed. The last-run diff (83f9a1d) touches only agents.d, the tail of the test file and the hook, and the overlay block and assertions are still at HEAD.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Note: the pass-1 TASK_GAP about `::name` under `prepush_test_command` override / `python3 <file>` runners is not a gap, because both cases are reported as `tests_file_names_ignored` in `unverified` and documented.
- HARDENING: workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py parse_tests_file `edge_control` / `_TESTS_FILE_CONTROL_RE` (line 133). `str.strip()` removes `\x85`/`\u2028`, which the regex does not match, so the line is silently accepted. Fix: widen the class to `[\x00-\x1f\x7f-\x9f\u2028\u2029]` or set `edge_control = raw.rstrip("\r").strip(" ") != line`. Estimated lines changed: 1. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
